articles.title: Royal Navy hit with fresh blow as workers building new warships vote to strike in pay row
articles.summary: Royal Navy warship builders at BAE Systems have voted to strike over a pay dispute, risking significant delays to warship production. This industrial action poses a fresh blow to the military's procurement schedule and readiness. Aspirants should understand how such industrial disputes can impact defence capabilities and strategic projects, emphasizing the critical link between industrial stability and national security preparedness.
